text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Resource observations distinguish the worker from Raven's supervisor
One-second process-tree snapshots · includes verification, retained-data audit and publication · no GPU measurements
Blue shading: verification pre/post identity guards. Green shading: study guards; these are not exact command start/stop times.
RSS snapshots may repeat shared pages and miss transient peaks. Current process-tree CPU seconds exclude departed processes.
The supervisor tree did not observe the Slurm worker. These are workload observations, not per-method inference costs or final scheduler accounting.
